Solution: 4|4 cm|4cm -> volume = length x width x height -> height = volume ÷ (width x length) = 96 ÷ (6 x 4) = 96 ÷ 24 = 4

Question Choices: A irregular solid can be break into two parts, a larger rectangular prism and a smaller rectangular prism. The larger one is measured as 4 m x 5 m x 6 m. The smaller one is measured as 2 m x 3 m x 2 m. What is the volume of this solid in cubic centimeter (cm³)?
Solution: 132 -> Total volume = smaller volume + larger volume = 4x5x6 + 2x3x2 = 132
